item.description: A distraught bystander tries to physically block masked looters from ransacking a Franprix supermarket during high school protests in Paris. "Why are you doing this?! This is not the cause!" she screams as employees watch helplessly from inside.

item.title: @faytuksnetwork: The fire at Limonges City Hall has resulted in a collapse of the building's clock tower as the inferno engulfed the roof
item.description: The fire at Limonges City Hall has resulted in a collapse of the building's clock tower as the inferno engulfed the roof this evening. The construction of the structure was completed in 1883 and was designated a "monument historique" by the French government in 1975.
